title: Why Hut 8 (HUT) Is Up 31.8% After Google AI Deal And $10 Billion Data Center Plan
title_zh: 谷歌 AI 交易和 100 亿美元数据中心计划后，Hut 8 (HUT) 为何上涨 31.8%
summary: In early April 2026, Hut 8’s pivot toward large-scale AI and compute infrastructure gained momentum as it advanced the US$10.00 billion, 245 MW River Bend data center and secured a 15-year leasing deal with Google that could reach up to US$17.70 billion in revenue if all renew...
summary_zh: 2026 年 4 月上旬，Hut 8 向大规模人工智能和计算基础设施的转型势头强劲，推进了耗资 100 亿美元、245 兆瓦的 River Bend 数据中心，并与谷歌达成了为期 15 年的租赁协议，如果全部续签，收入可能高达 177 亿美元……

title: Jim Cramer Shows Positive Sentiment Toward Broadcom’s Google and Anthropic Deals
title_zh: Jim Cramer 对 Broadcom 的 Google 和 Anthropic 交易表现出积极的态度
summary: Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) is one of Jim Cramer’s stock calls as he discussed the impact of the Iran war on the markets. Cramer highlighted the company’s recent deals, as he said: When Marvell Tech won some big business recently, it came at the expense of Broadcom.
summary_zh: 博通公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AVGO）是吉姆·克莱默（Jim Cramer）在讨论伊朗战争对市场的影响时所关注的股票之一。 Cramer 强调了该公司最近的交易，他表示：当 Marvell Tech 最近赢得了一些大业务时，它是以牺牲 Broadcom 为代价的。

title: Stock Market Today, April 9: CoreWeave Rises After Announcing $21 Billion AI Cloud Deal With Meta
title_zh: 4 月 9 日今日股市：CoreWeave 宣布与 Meta 达成 210 亿美元人工智能云交易后股价上涨
summary: Today, April 9, 2026, investors weigh a massive Meta cloud pact against fresh debt plans.
summary_zh: 今天，即 2026 年 4 月 9 日，投资者将权衡大规模的 Meta 云协议与新的债务计划。

title: SBA Communications Stock Soars on Buyout Interest. What It Means for Tower Stocks.
title_zh: SBA Communications 股价因收购兴趣而飙升。这对塔楼股票意味着什么。
summary: SBA Communications stock has surged on takeover interest, but analysts warn a potential deal could cap valuations across the tower industry.
summary_zh: SBA Communications 股价因收购兴趣而飙升，但分析师警告称，潜在的交易可能会限制整个铁塔行业的估值。

title: Meta expands CoreWeave partnership with new $21B AI cloud deal
title_zh: Meta 通过新的 21B 美元人工智能云交易扩大了 CoreWeave 合作伙伴关系
summary: Meta Platforms (META) is doubling down on its partnership with CoreWeave (CRWV) through a new $21 billion deal to better leverage CoreWeave's AI cloud platform for scale. Meta also released its new Muse Spark AI model earlier this week.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 通过一项价值 210 亿美元的新交易，加倍加强与 CoreWeave (CRWV) 的合作关系，以更好地利用 CoreWeave 的 AI 云平台实现规模化。 Meta 本周早些时候还发布了新的 Muse Spark AI 模型。
